title: The Powerpuff Girls Creator Reveals Reboot Pitch Was Rejected Ahead of New Movie Revival
content:
The creator behind the massively popular The Powerpuff Girls franchise has revealed that his take on a reboot has fallen through despite a new movie revival now being in the works with Warner Bros. Animation. The Powerpuff Girls has had a strange trajectory over the last few decades as with the original series coming to an end over 20 years ago, fans have seen attempts to bring it back with new reboots or adaptations that have notoriously failed for one reason or another .

One common denominator for each of these failures, however, was the fact that original creator Craig McCracken was not involved in either of those attempts. Things seemed to change back in 2022 when it was revealed that McCracken had signed a deal to develop a new version of The Powerpuff Girls for Warner Bros. Animation , but in speaking on the Makin’ Toons podcast , McCracken reveals that his reboot has since fallen through as it couldn’t settle on what kind of form it would take.

The Powerpuff Girls Reboot From Original Creator Was Rejected

When it was originally revealed that McCracken had signed a deal to develop a new version of The Powerpuff Girls and Foster’s Home for Imaginary Friends , fans had been concerned over the past few years as only the new version of Foster’s seemed to be moving forward . But now that’s been confirmed by McCracken to be the case as a new Powerpuff Girls just didn’t work out, “A few years ago I signed a deal with Warner Bros. to develop a Powerpuff thing and a Foster’s thing. The Foster’s thing went, the Powerpuff didn’t.” As McCracken explained, it was because demands kept changing.

McCracken noted how shifting changes in streaming services and what they wanted in particular meant that a new version of The Powerpuff Girls was harder to put together, “At the time it was like, ‘What’s a serialized version of Powerpuff that’s long form that we could sell to a place like Netflix?’ Okay, they’re not looking for that anymore. ‘What’s a movie? Do you have a movie?’ Now they’re looking for movies. Okay, they’re not looking for movies anymore, so it just keeps shifting.” But that raises questions about what’s next.

What Does This Mean for the New Powerpuff Girls Movie?

It was revealed earlier this year during the Annecy International Animation Film Festival 2026 that Warner Bros. Animation was developing a new Powerpuff Girls movie , but it was unclear as to whether or not the film was actually being greenlit at the time. It was also not revealed whether or not McCracken would be involved with the new project, and these comments about the failed reboot’s production make it seem like McCracken might not be involved with this new feature film version either.

Both the 2010s reboot series and failed live-action adaptation attempts fell through without McCracken’s involvement , and it could end up being the same case here if this movie moves forward without one of the original minds behind the project overall. There’s also no guarantee this happens either with all of the shake ups now happening as a result of the Skydance merger, so we’ll have to see what’s next for The Powerpuff Girls .

What are you hoping to see from The Powerpuff Girls ‘ future? Let us know all of your thoughts about it in the comments!

HT – Makin’ Toons

title: Deadline: Noah Of The Blood Sea Manga Gets Hollywood Live-Action Film Adaptation
content:
Tyrus Pictures' Michael Zelman and Hamid Mokhneche are producing. The studio is optioning the film adaptation rights from Takeshobo .

In addition, Deadline reported that the original manga is getting an English release in North America. The manga is also getting a release in Taiwan.

The manga's story centers on a luxury cruise ship where the passengers mysteriously die due to vampires.

Satomi debuted the manga on Takeshobo 's Web Comic Gamma website in August 2018, and ended it in June 2021. Takeshobo published the manga's fifth and final compiled book volume in June 2021.

title: Shonen Jump Gets Ready to End More Manga With 3 New Titles Revealed for 2026
content:
Shueisha’s Weekly Shonen Jump magazine is gearing up to end even more of its series (or cancel them) as three new titles have been revealed to be on their way to the magazine through the rest of the year. It’s been a stronger year for Shonen Jump than last year as by this time last year, there had been around ten or so series cancelled . But this year it’s been much fewer with longer running titles coming to their respective ends instead. Though it’s time to get ready to clear up more space.

Shonen Jump has revealed that one of their long running titles is readying to release its final chapter next week after five years of serialization with Kenta Shinohara’s Witch Watch coming to an end. But Shueisha has also announced three new titles that will be kicking off their serialization through the end of the year, and they include some returning creators behind hits like Mission: Yozakura Family among them. So it’s time to get ready for more endings soon.

Shonen Jump Reveals 3 New Titles From New and Returning Creators

As Witch Watch prepares to end with the release of its next chapter, the first of these new titles will be making its debut with the next week’s issue as well. The first of these new series is titled “Jean ga Abunai!” and was created by Ryo Nakama, the same mind behind High School Family: Kokosei Kazoku . That series ran with Shonen Jump for three years following its debut in 2020, and is even coming to screens with a new live-action feature film too . But Nakama isn’t the only returning name either.

The second new title coming the week after is “Gindara Uradouri Kouban no Hizuki-san” from Hitsuji Gondaira, the same creator behind Mission: Yozakura Family . That series had a notable six year run with Shonen Jump from 2019 to 2025, and was one of the more solid action releases of the early 2020s. The anime is now in the midst of its latest season airing new episodes this Fall too , so it’s great to see the creator already on the way back with another new work that will hopefully follow in that level of success.

What Does This Mean for Shonen Jump in 2026?

The third new title coming a week after that is “Tonari no Tennis-bu no Kimi to.,” from Shinobu Kasaya, who’s had a few smaller successes here and there but nothing as notable as the other two. These new Shonen Jump series have yet to confirm their English licensed titles as of this time, but they are something to look forward to as it means there are likely going to be another one or two titles coming to an end after Witch Watch . The next likely being Yuto Suzuki’s Sakamoto Days as it just ended its own final battle .

When looking back on what has ended or been cancelled through the year so far, it’s been a wild 2026 for Shonen Jump magazine with the loss of the following titles:

• Otr of the Flame

• Harukaze Mound

• Gonron Egg

• The Mage Next Door

• Hero Girl and Demon Lord Call It Quits

• Alien Headbutt

• Kinato’s Magic

• Drawn to the Fire

• Jujutsu Kaisen Modulo

• Hima-ten!

• Blue Box

• The Elusive Samurai

We’ll have to see what the end of the year looks like for Shonen Jump when it’s all over, but what are you hoping to see with these new titles? Let us know all of your thoughts about it in the comments!

title: Netflix Locks Down January 2027 Release for New Anime – Watch the Trailer
content:
2027 has been stacking up to be a huge new year for anime , and Netflix is making things even more enticing as they have locked down a January 2027 launch for a cool new anime series coming our way. Although the Fall 2026 anime schedule has been firing off on all cylinders with each of its new releases thus far, fans can’t help but look forward to all of the new releases coming to screens next year. And one of these new hits is coming exclusively to Netflix.

Keigo Shinzo’s Hirayasumi has been a pretty neat manga to see unfold ever since it made its original debut with Shogakukan’s Weekly Big Comic Spirits magazine in 2021 , and now it’s finally going to get an official anime adaptation after six years. Coming our way next January as part of the Winter 2027 anime schedule, it’s now been announced that the new series will be exclusively streaming with Netflix outside of its release in Japan. You can check it out in action below.

Hirayasumi Anime Confirms January 2027 Release With Netflix

Hirayasumi will be making its debut sometime next January as part of the Winter 2027 anime schedule , but has yet to confirm a concrete release date as of this time. The series will be exclusively be streaming its episodes with Netflix outside of Japan, and this newly revealed update has confirmed that Gen Hoshino will be providing the opening theme. No title for it has been revealed as of this time, but TOMOO has been confirmed to provide the ending theme titled “Fumi Zekka.” It’s all steadily coming together too with the reveal of its voice cast and production staff.

Kei Suezawa will be writing and directing the series for Production +h and Shogakukan with Naoyuki Asano providing the character designs, Mika Nishimura serving as art director, and Kaori Sawada composing the music. The extended voice cast for the anime includes the likes of Yuma Uchida as Hiroto Ikuta, Mayu Takahashi as Natsumi Kobayashi, Rikako Aikawa as Hanae Wada, Daisuke Namikawa as Hideki Noguchi, Yoko Hikasa as Yomogi Tachibana, Yume Miyamoto as Akari Yokoyama, Yuichiro Umehara as Ryo Ishikawa, and Yuko Naito as the narrator.

What to Know About Hirayasumi

Hirayasumi isn’t the most explosive series you’ll dive into, but that’s also what makes it truly stand out from the rest of the pack. The series introduces Hiroto, a young man on the cusp of turning 30 with no real direction in his life. But he wants it that way as he’s spending all of his time just living day to day and enjoying his free time. Bonding with an older woman, the two of them become such good friends that she leaves her house to him after her passing. When his cousin moves in while she goes to school, Hiroto’s life begins to change in unexpected ways.

It’s a slice of life series where it’s all just about these characters living out their lives in peace and without much drama, and that makes it a compelling read. If the anime can tap into that same energy when it hits next year, it’s going to be a big hit. What are you hoping to see from Hirayasumi ‘s anime debut? Let us know all of your thoughts about it in the comments.

title: Manga Up! Global Adds Love Unseen Beneath the Clear Night Sky, Underdog Idol, 3 More Manga
content:
Square Enix 's Manga UP! Global service added five manga titles in English over the past 10 days:

Get ready for a chaotic and comedic newlywed life packed with hilarious mishaps between an eccentric noble bride and a rigid, straight-laced marquis!

Alsrod, the protagonist, had trained hard to receive Spellsword as his profession in his bestowal ceremony. However, the profession bestowed upon him was...

“Oda Nobunaga.”

A name so mysterious, no one was sure if it even was a profession.

However, it was the strongest, most overpowered profession which completely changed his fate!

title: Black Clover Season 2 Preview Teases Noelle’s Big Fight Reaching Its Climax
content:
Black Clover Season 2 is in the midst of Noelle Silva’s toughest fight yet, and the first look at the next episode of the series is setting up for her fight’s big climax. Black Clover Season 2 has been running at full speed ever since it kicked off its run this Fall, and fans have seen all sorts of explosive moments thus far. With its adaptation of the Spade Kingdom Raid arc from Yuki Tabata’s original manga, it’s been one notable moment for each of the characters after the other.

Black Clover Season 2 has thrown Noelle right into the thick of things as the latest episode saw her fight Vanica to kick off their long awaited rematch. But thanks to training in the Heart Kingdom, Noelle has been able to reach a new level of power strong enough to temporarily match Vanica’s strength. But things quickly escalated, and the first look at Black Clover Season 2 Episode 7 teases what’s next. You can check it out below.

Black Clover Season 2 Episode 7 Reveals Release Date & Synopsis

Black Clover Season 2 Episode 7 is titled “Beyond Despair,” and will be making its debut in Japan on November 14th, and will be streaming exclusively with Crunchyroll when it hits for fans in North America and other international territories. But as the synopsis for the episode teases, things are looking grim for Noelle and the others following Megicula’s arrival, “Noelle and her companions are unable to use their magic as they wish due to the curse magic of the highest-ranking demon, Megicula. Gaja’s life-risking suicide attack is also thwarted, leaving them in a desperate situation.”

But it seems like a sudden arrival will be changing things quickly, “ Just then, Asta and Luck arrive . They prevent the worst-case scenario and intensify their offensive against Megicula once again,” the synopsis continues further. “A fierce battle ensues between Megicula and the Magic Knights. In the midst of the battle, who should suddenly appear on the battlefield…?” It seems like there are going to be even more fighters jumping into the fray to help (or hurt) Noelle, but it should be her that delivers the final blow in order to fully wrap her character arc in this war with the Spade Kingdom.

What’s Next for Noelle in Black Clover ?

With this being the climax of Noelle’s fight against Megicula, this also means it’s likely going to be one of her final solo moments in the season overall. If Noelle is able to successfully take down this demon, it would only leave one fight left to settle in order to stop the Advent of Qliphoth arc. But as teased by the new season opening , and all of the devils who has slipped out of the underworld so far, there’s still even more threats to keep an eye out for in the coming episodes.

Black Clover Season 2 has some big fights still coming its way through the rest of the Spade Kingdom Raid arc, but it’s only all set up for what’s coming next in the final arc from Yuki Tabata’s original manga series . Noelle and the others still have some bigger moments to keep an eye out for in the anime’s future, but cede future has yet to be fully revealed as of this time. What are you hoping to see next from Noelle in Black Clover ‘s anime? Let us know all of your thoughts about it in the comments.

title: Comikey Licenses The Emperor's Treasure, Gakuen Babysitters, 4 More Titles
content:
The digital comic distributor Comikey announced on Friday it has licensed the following titles for release through November:

Title: The Emperor's Treasure ( Mikado no Shihō ) webtoon Author(s): Emiko Nakano Platform Debut: November 9 Summary: "Your Highness... Who is that girl...?" "Why... she's my treasure."

The people of the Sho Dynasty are impoverished and starving.

Though her petite stature often leads others to mistake her for a child, eighteen-year-old Koran is determined to save her struggling village. Living alongside her adoptive father—the local doctor and village head—she decides to take matters into her own hands. To help pay off their crushing taxes, Koran sneaks into the imperial palace in search of treasure, only to cross paths with the incredibly handsome Shiki!

The very next morning, rumors of an assassin murdering the crown prince throw the nation into chaos. Koran immediately suspects Shiki is the killer—so what is she to make of his shockingly gentle nature?!

Title: The Plebeian: Beyond the Bloodline Elite ( Kettou Shijou Shugi Meika no Youshi no Yarinaoshi ) webtoon Author(s): Soukai Studio Platform Debut: November 16 Summary: In a world where bloodline supremacy reigns supreme, magic was the privilege of the nobility. However, with the invasion of demons, the magic of the nobility becomes powerless, and the world heads towards destruction.

Humanity's last hope lies with Colin, the strongest swordsman of slave origin. Just before his death, he obtains the “Forbidden Book,” which allows anyone to learn magic. When he awakens, he finds himself five years in the past, as a boy. This time, to change the future for good, Colin will rule the world as a “Magic Swordsman,” possessing both sword and magic, and save humanity from the demons!

Title: School Babysitters ( Gakuen Babysitters ) manga Author(s): Hari Tokeino Platform Debut: November 20 Summary: "Those who are gone won't ever come back, but that doesn't mean we've been left all alone in this world"

After losing their parents in a plane crash, Ryuichi and his younger brother, Kotaro, are taken in by the Chairwoman of Morinomiya Academy... There's just one surprising condition: Ryuichi must take up the mantle of school babysitter!

How will Ryuichi handle the group of adorable yet endlessly energetic toddlers...?!

Title: The Oppressed Saint and Her Loyal Duke ( Shiitagerare Seijo to Ichizu Koushaku - Kari Hajime Kon no Hazu ga, Dekiai Sareteimasu ) manga Author(s): Sayuri Shichifuku, Michi Kogoma Platform Debut: November 22 Summary: "Do you wanna be with me?"

Saint Blanche continued to fulfill her duty as the Saint, even while being oppressed by her fiance, Georg, the prince of the neighboring country. However, she was suddenly told that her engagement was canceled-because Georg had found the "true" Saint-and exiled Blanche from the country.

Blanche returned to her hometown, but ... her worried brother suggested that she make a fake engagement with her childhood friend, Raymond. Suddenly turning into a childhood crush to a fiance, Blanche is constantly flustered by Raymond. A love fantasy of unrequited love begins to unfold from their fake engagement!

Title: Mr. Kusakabe's Gentle Love ( Kusakabe Kachou no Koi wa Yawaraka ) manga Author(s): AJITA Platform Debut: November 26 Summary: "Sana, self-conscious about her weight, is confused by her manager Mr. Kusakabe's constant glare."

One day, she slips on the stairs, but Mr. Kusakabe catches her, and her embarrassment grows, certain he now thinks she's heavy. But when she confronts him about his stares, he blushes and confesses his love, revealing his "glaring" was actually a sign of affection. He then asks her on a date in this cute office romance.

Title: My Fake Marriage: Could His Love Be Real? title: SEGA Confirms Leak of 2.2 Million Newsletter Recipients' Email Addresses
content:
SEGA reported on Monday that the email addresses of 2,196,044 customers have been leaked after an unnamed third party accessed the systems of Arara, the company whose distribution system SEGA and SEGA Fave uses for their email newsletters. SEGA said that Arara is currently investigating the cause of the unauthorized access and is taking measures to prevent further damage.

SEGA has confirmation that email addresses and information associated with the newsletters' delivery have been leaked, but it emphasized there are no indications that customers' names, birthdates, genders, postal addresses, phone numbers, credit card information, and login passwords have also been leaked, as of the time of the announcement. SEGA also noted that a different distribution system handles the email addresses registered on customers' SEGA Accounts, and therefore the leak does not affect those addresses.

SEGA stated that the leaked email addresses leaked were from 11 affected newsletters sent in July, September, and October. Of the 2,196,044 leaked email addresses, 92,273 also had information associated with newsletter delivery leaked. Six of the 11 affected newsletters are tied to the " SEGA Lucky Kuji Online" prize game service, which is already undergoing maintenance, as part of security checks following a separate incident of unauthorized server access to SEGA Fave's arcade game network services.

SEGA Fave announced on November 2 that a third party accessed its servers without authorization, unrelated to the above leak of newsletter recipients' email addresses. The affected SEGA Fave servers are those for the arcade game network service ALL.Net and Aime (cards used by certain arcade games to store player information). The company suspended various related services for security checks on November 1, and services for some games remain unavailable. In addition to Sega itself, other companies such as Bandai Namco also use the affected services for certain arcade games.

title: Dragon Quest Teases New RPG for iOS, Android
content:
The Dragon Quest franchise announced Dragon Quest RPG: Makai-Ju to Michibikareshi Shima ( Dragon Quest RPG: The Demon World Tree and the Shepherded Island), a new game for iOS and Android devices, on Monday. Square Enix will debut the new game's announcement trailer on Tuesday at 8:00 p.m. JST (6:00 a.m. EST).

The Dragon Quest Monsters: Super Light mobile game launched in January 2014. The game ended its service in January 2024, making it the longest running Dragon Quest smartphone game, for almost 10 years.

The Dragon Quest Dokodemo Monster Parade smartphone game, which launched in 2015, ended its service in July 2020. The Dragon Quest: The Adventure of Dai smartphone game launched in September 2021, and ended its service in April 2023.

Dragon Quest Tact , the franchise 's tactical, role-playing smartphone game launched for iOS and Android devices in Japan in July 2020, and saw a Western release in January 2021. The game ended service in the West in February 2024.

The global version of Dragon Quest of the Stars ( Hoshi no Dragon Quest ) smartphone role-playing game launched in February 2020. The game ended service in June 2021. The game had the largest world in the series' history, and its focus was on exploring the world and fighting monsters.

title: Late Tetsuya Chiba's Autobiographical Manga to End in 8th Volume
content:
Chiba launched the Hinemosu Notari Nikki autobiographical short essay manga in Big Comic in December 2015. Shogakukan published the manga's first compiled book volume in 2018, and the seventh volume in November 2025. Chiba put the manga on hiatus on September 25, citing poor health. Chiba died on October 22 due to a myelodysplastic syndrome, a type of cancer that affects the blood cells in the bone marrow.

Chiba debuted as a professional manga creator when he was still in high school at 17 years old in 1956. He is perhaps best known for his Ashita no Joe ( Tomorrow's Joe ) boxing manga, which ran from 1968 to 1973, and has remained a mainstay in Japanese popular culture for decades. The manga inspired two television anime in 1970 and 1980, as well as two anime films in 1980 and 1981. The manga's story was re-imagined in a new sci-fi setting with new characters in 2018's Megalobox anime, which credits the original manga as its origin. The sequel series for Megalobox , Megalobox 2: Nomad , premiered in April 2021.

Ashita no Joe received its first official English release under the title Ashita no Joe: Fighting for Tomorrow in December 2024.

Chiba was nominated to the Japan Art Academy in 2022 as one of its first two manga creators (along with Yoshiharu Tsuge ). He was also the chair of the Japan Cartoonists Association.

Chiba was honored with the prestigious Order of Culture award in 2024, and was the first manga creator to have received the honor. The order is awarded to those "who have made outstanding contributions in developing" Japanese culture.
